summary: David says Yahweh is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? Yahweh is strength of my life of whom shall I be afraid? When evildoers came to eat my flesh adversaries stumbled and fell. Though army encamp against me heart will not fear though war rise I will be confident. One thing I asked of Yahweh that will I seek after: that I may dwell in house of Yahweh all days of my life to see beauty of Yahweh and inquire in his temple. For in day of trouble he will keep me secret in pavilion, set me high upon rock, now head lifted above enemies, I will offer in his tent sacrifices of joy, sing. Hear Yahweh when I cry with my voice have mercy answer, when you said seek my face my heart said Your face Yahweh will I seek, don't hide face, don't put servant away in anger, you have been my help. Though my father and mother forsake me Yahweh will take me up. Teach me your way lead in level path because of enemies, don't deliver to will of adversaries false witnesses breathe violence. I would have despaired unless I had believed to see goodness of Yahweh in land of living. Wait for Yahweh be strong let heart take courage yes wait for Yahweh.
whyItMatters: Psalm of confidence and longing — one thing I asked dwell in house, and waiting. Contains 'Yahweh is my light and salvation whom shall I fear?' and 'Wait for Yahweh.' Shows both confidence and lingering trouble.

keyVerses.text: By David. Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
keyVerses.why: Opening — light salvation strength — whom shall I fear? Whom shall I be afraid?

keyVerses.text: One thing I have asked of Yahweh, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in Yahweh’s house all the days of my life, to see Yahweh’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.
keyVerses.why: One thing — dwell to see beauty and inquire — focus of desire.

keyVerses.text: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
keyVerses.why: Closing — wait be strong take courage, double wait.

questions.question: What does 'Yahweh is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? Strength of my life of whom be afraid?' mean?
questions.answer: Light and salvation and strength are three images: light dispels darkness and shows way, salvation rescues from danger, strength is stronghold or refuge. Whom shall I fear / of whom afraid forms rhetorical questions expecting no one. Even if evildoers came to eat flesh (like beasts) they stumbled and fell (self-defeat). Though army encamp and war rise, confidence remains — not because no army, but because light/salvation/strength is Yahweh. For first-time reader, it's not bravado but anchoring fear in bigger reality.

questions.question: What is 'one thing I asked dwell in house of Yahweh all days to see beauty and inquire'?
questions.answer: One thing — single focus among many needs. Dwell in house = not just visit but reside in temple presence. See beauty — noem, pleasantness, loveliness of Yahweh, and inquire (baqar) in temple — seek, investigate, meditate. For David not yet temple built, tabernacle or desire for presence. In day of trouble he will hide in pavilion (sukka shelter) high rock — protection, then head lifted above enemies, sacrifices of joy singing. Shows desire not just deliverance from trouble but nearness to see beauty.

questions.question: Why shift from confidence to crying 'Hear when I cry, don't hide face, though father mother forsake, wait for Yahweh'?
questions.answer: Psalm has two halves: confident declaration (1-6) and petition (7-14). Even confident person still cries, fears hiding of face, being put away in anger, being forsaken even by parents (ultimate earthly attachment) but Yahweh will take me up (asaf — gather). Then request: teach me way, level path because of enemies, false witnesses breathing violence. Then testimony: I would have despaired unless believed to see goodness in land of living (not just afterlife). Ends with wait be strong let heart take courage yes wait — double wait for emphasis. Shows faith includes waiting, not instant resolution.

glossary.def: Three images: light dispels, salvation rescues, strength refuge.
Single focus — dwell in house to see beauty and inquire, not many things.
Wait, hope, expect — active waiting exchanging strength.
